name: Fatehold Charm
oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Draw a card. Empower Jace 2.
• Return target spell or creature to its owner's hand.
• Creatures you control get +1/+2 until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: • Return target spell or creature to its owner's hand.

needs.what: a single 'target spell or creature' spec: one target whose legal choices are any spell on the stack or a creature permanent, so the Creature restriction narrows only the permanent half (return_spell_to_hand already handles either half of a spell_or_permanent target)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: kind 'spell_or_permanent' applies its one selector to both halves, so types: [Creature] would restrict the spell half to creature spells; any_of branches cannot name a zone to tell a spell from a permanent, and two target specs would be a card that targets twice
